profile.goodFor: silencing noise and spill between notes: drums, noisy guitars and vocals

settings.name: Range
settings.what: how far it turns down when closed: Silent, or only a few dB for a gentler gate

settings.name: Release
settings.what: how fast it closes after the sound falls

settings.name: Hold
settings.what: how long it stays open before closing

settings.name: Hysteresis
settings.what: how far below the threshold it must fall to close; stops chattering

settings.name: Sidechain
settings.what: open by its own sound or by another channel's
